text.p: Following are some of the major events to have occurred on November 5 in history.
1556 - Akhbar the Great Mughal routed the Hindus under Hemu by turning their elephants against them at the battle of Panipat in the Hindu revolt.
1854 - In the Crimean War, British and French armies defeated a Russian force of 50,000 at the battle of Inkerman; 12,000 Russians were killed in the battle.
1895 - German pianist Walter Gieseking born; he was best known for his playing of Ravel and Debussy.
1905 - U.S. film actor Joel McCrea born.
1911 - Italy announced the annexation of Libya, Tripolitania and Cyrenaica.
1911 - U.S. singing cowboy Roy Rogers born as Leonard Slye. He was a star in films from 1935 and later in television, usually with his horse "Trigger".
1911 - The first transcontinental flight across the United States ended at Pasadena. Pilot C.P. Snow took off from Sheepshead Bay, New York, on September 17 and covered a distance of 3,417 miles.
1912 - Woodrow Wilson won the U.S. presidential election, becoming the only president to defeat two former presidents (Taft and Roosevelt) in one election.
1913 - Vivien Leigh, British film actress who Oscars for "Gone with the Wind" and "A Streetcar named Desire", born.
1914 - France declared war on Turkey.
1922 - Howard Carter discovered the tomb of Tutankhamun in the Valley of the Kings near Luxor in Egypt.
1928 - Mount Etna in Sicily erupted, destroying a large area. The village of Mascali was completely buried
1940 - President Franklin D. Roosevelt was re-elected president of the United States for the third time, defeating Wendell Wilkie.
1965 - Rhodesian Prime Minister Ian Smith declared a state of emergency in preparation for his unilateral declaration of independence from Britain.
1968 - Richard Nixon won the U.S. presidential election by a narrow margin over Hubert Humphrey.
1978 - Iranian Prime Minister Jaafar Sharif-Emami resigned following riots and demonstrations against the Shah.
1982 - French film director and actor Jacques Tati, best known for his films "Mr Hulot's Holidays" and "My Uncle", died.
1989 - Lebanon's Syrian-backed acting Prime Minister Selim Hoss, a Sunni Moslem, resigned after parliament elected Rene Muawad as Lebanon's new president.
1989 - Vladimir Horowitz, one of the century's greatest pianists, died. He was 85 and had last performed publicly in the spring of 1987.
1990 - Meir Kahane, an American-born rabbi who advocated expelling all Arabs from Israel, was shot dead in NewYork.
1991 - Czech-born British media tycoon Robert Maxwell died after falling overboard off his yacht.
1995 - Former Italian prime minister Giulio Andreotti was charged with complicity in murder
